portrait_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OtakuSoul character card portrait. Create one solo vertical waist-up anime illustration of Ainz Ooal Gown (Momonga) from Overlord, imposing skeletal undead sorcerer. Ivory skull with anatomically skeletal rigid jaw and no flesh, two small glowing red points inside deep black eye sockets. Elaborate black high-collared ceremonial robes with broad purple and gold trim, massive gold shoulder pieces and red gemstone ornaments. Hands out of frame. Dignified composed frontal stance. Faithful recognizable character design with polished clean linework, rich dark-fantasy cel shading. Centered, full head and accessories visible with ample headroom, subtly blurred Nazarick gothic hall background, soft cinematic light, clear face. No text, logo, watermark, panels, border or other characters. SFW.
